correctness.rationale: Checked total 2-cut K=(Cl G)^* and triangle-freeness for m,n≥4; equivariant combinatorial Alexander duality concentrates integral reduced homology at mn−4, rank |E|−|V|+1=mn+1, with vertex-orientation twist. The torus CW exact sequence ker ∂₂=Z(sum of mn squares), im ∂₂=B=ε⊗(Z[F]/ZΣF), H₁(G)/B≅H₁(torus)=Z² is natural under coordinate dihedral Γ. For translations T, all invariant graph 1-chains are integer sums of the two transitive oriented-edge orbit totals X,Y; they are cycles and map to n·e₁,m·e₂ in torus winding. A T-equivariant lift of q·e_i exists iff n|q or m|q, giving exact extension summand orders n,m and total lcm; duality preserves integral Ext order for free lattices. Rational splitting, orientation determinant on faces and trace on H₁(torus) give the stated character. Independently reconstructed winding orbit counts for 4×4,4×5,5×7,6×8; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the all-size extension order. The stated Γ need not be the full exceptional automorphism group.

originality.rationale: Searched Resultary total-cut toroidal products, integral extension, duality and equivariant characters, and published original work. Bayer et al. introduces total-cut complexes and examples; Chandrakar et al. studies rectangular path grids; Carnero Bravo 2026 full text §5.4 treats Cartesian products of paths and complete graphs. Chauhan–Shukla–Vinayak 2025 full text treats cycle powers and K_m□P_n/K_m□C_n, neither of which contains C_m□C_n with m,n≥4, because C_m is not a complete graph for m≥4. Their nonequivariant wedge counts are in any case not integral T-lattice extension-class order. No compared published theorem determines the exact lcm obstruction for toroidal graphs. Residual possibility of an unindexed equivariant torus-chain formulation remains.

value.rationale: The exact lcm(m,n) is a nontrivial integral representation-theoretic obstruction invisible to the nonequivariant homology rank and to rational character. It quantifies precisely how primitive torus winding classes fail to lift translation-invariantly into graph-cycle homology, while the full rational character identifies the complete natural coordinate-symmetry action. This is a uniform structural invariant, not a routine individual sphere census.

final_claim: For G=C_m□C_n, m,n≥4, the integral face–winding homology extension of the total 2-cut complex restricted to the translation group has additive order lcm(m,n); the rational Γ-character is sgn_V(g)[det(A_g)(f(g)−1)+tr(A_g)].
limitations: m,n≥4, graph simple and triangle-free; no triangular factors or exceptional full automorphism-group assertion.
Extension order is over Z[T], not rational Γ-representation splitting or equivariant homotopy.
